data.standardized_narrative: Unable to reliably extract gross claims opening balance or a gross prioryear reserve movement from the provided images. The report images contain technical account tables, a claims development table and segmental premium analysis, but text and numeric fields required for prior year development and opening gross claims outstanding are not legible enough for definitive extraction.
data.data_quality_notes: Document images are low-resolution/rotated and many numeric lines are not legible by OCR. I could reliably read the total gross premiums written (reported in the accounts as 153,646 GBP 000 -> 153.646 million GBP). I could not confidently locate or read the Balance Sheet 'Claims outstanding' prior-year comparative column or a clear gross 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' note. A claims development triangle appears in the images (around page 43) but the individual cell values could not be extracted with confidence. All other requested reserve-specific fields are therefore null or empty. If you can provide higher-resolution or correctly-oriented images of the Balance Sheet (liabilities / technical provisions) and the Technical Reserves note (movement in prior years) I can extract precise figures.
